text: 从环比看，全国PPI上涨0.7%，涨幅比上月回落0.5个百分点。本月PPI环比运行的主要特点：一是输入性和季节性因素影响主要能源相关行业价格上涨。国际能源价格上行带动国内石油和天然气开采业、煤炭开采和洗选业价格分别上涨6.0%和2.7%；受上游基础能源价格传导和迎峰度冬关键准备期电煤及燃气需求释放等因素影响，下游精炼石油产品制造、有机化学原料制造、煤炭加工、燃气生产和供应业价格分别上涨6.8%、6.8%、3.2%和1.5%，6个行业合计影响PPI环比上涨约0.61个百分点，超过总涨幅的八成。
text_en: On a month-on-month basis, the national PPI rose 0.7%, 0.5 percentage points lower than the previous month. The main features of this month's PPI month-on-month performance: First, input and seasonal factors affected price increases in major energy-related industries. Rising international energy prices drove domestic oil and natural gas extraction and coal mining and washing prices up 6.0% and 2.7%, respectively; affected by the transmission of upstream basic energy prices and the release of demand for thermal coal and gas during the key preparation period for winter peak demand, downstream refined petroleum product manufacturing, organic chemical raw material manufacturing, coal processing, and gas production and supply prices rose 6.8%, 6.8%, 3.2% and 1.5%, respectively. Together, the six industries contributed about 0.61 percentage points to the month-on-month increase in PPI, more than 80% of the total increase.
